 The text is extensively cited and explained in the *Vimānavatthu-aṭṭhakathā* (matching segments §1.1–9.1), with further overlaps occurring in the *Petavatthu-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. Significant structural and formulaic parallels occur within the *Vimānavatthu* itself, most notably with the companion text *Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavatthu* (Vv 14, sharing §0.1–9.1), *Guttilavimānavatthu* (Vv 33), and *Tiladakkhiṇavimānavatthu* (Vv 10) [DharmaNexus]. Across linguistic traditions, DharmaNexus notes weak formulaic alignments with the Tibetan translation of the *Jātakamālā* (D4150), though these reflect stock poetic phrasing rather than historical parallels [DharmaNexus].
